text.tspan: Higher Levels of Integrity of Public Functions Achieved
Office of the State Minister for
Clearly defined roles and responsibilities of public officials within a modern
structure of the overall public sector.
Standards of transparency and merit applied and respected in the recruitment,
placement, transfer, promotion, compensation and non-salary benefits.
A modern and integrated system to promote ethical behavior in public
administrations, institution and municipalities established and implemented.
Independence and effectiveness of the Civil Service Bureau enhanced.
